title: 雨夜来信
hook:
母亲去世三年后
我收到她的来信

characters.name: 林宁
characters.appearance: adult East Asian woman age 25, short straight black bob haircut, round thin black glasses, mustard yellow cardigan over cream shirt, navy blue trousers, white sneakers

cover_scene: Lin alone inside an old Chinese house holding a faded closed envelope, surprised worried expression, rain on the window behind her, warm amber desk lamp, medium shot, envelope completely blank

panels.scene: Lin stands just inside the open wooden doorway of an old house at rainy night, she looks down at a faded blank envelope on the floor, three-quarter medium shot, one person only
panels.source_quote: 一封泛黄的信就从门缝里滑了出来

texts.text: 母亲去世第三年，我在老屋门口收到了一封信。

panels.scene: Lin alone seated at a wooden table holding a closed blank faded envelope with both hands, stunned face and trembling lips, close-up face and shoulders, warm desk light
panels.source_quote: 背面是母亲熟悉的字迹

texts.text: 可她已经离开我三年了。

panels.scene: Lin kneeling on a simple kitchen floor beside a window, one loose square floor tile lies beside her, she stares at one brass key inside the shallow square recess, medium shot, one person only
panels.source_quote: 底下果然躺着一把黄铜钥匙

texts.text: 按照信里的指示，我掀开了厨房的地砖。

texts.speaker: 林宁
texts.text: 这里真的藏着一把钥匙！

panels.scene: Lin standing still in front of one closed blue wooden basement door, holding a simple brass key at chest height, narrow strip of warm light beneath the door, side medium shot
panels.source_quote: 我拿着钥匙走到地下室门前

texts.text: 信上说：午夜前，打开地下室的蓝门。
无论里面的人说什么，都不要回答。

panels.scene: Lin frozen beside the still closed blue basement door, her hand covers her mouth, terrified eyes looking toward the closed door, warm light underneath, close-up of her face, nobody else visible
panels.source_quote: 门里就传出了父亲的声音

texts.text: 门里忽然传来父亲的声音，催我进去。
可是，父亲明明还在外地出差。

panels.scene: Lin steps back from the closed blue wooden basement door, clutching a blank letter against her chest, the light beneath the door has gone dark, frightened wide eyes, medium shot, no writing anywhere
panels.source_quote: 这一次，它叫的不是我的名字

texts.text: 灯灭了。门内又叫了我一声。
这次，是只有母亲才知道的小名。

cliffhanger:
原本空白的纸角
竟慢慢浮现出第二行字……

post.title: 母亲去世三年后，我收到她的来信
post.body:
一封来信，一把钥匙，一扇从未打开的蓝门。门里的声音，为什么知道那个小名？
这是原创技术演示节选，不对应真实推广任务。
